description: Use this when the person wants their saved resume aimed at a specific job. Takes resumeId and the job ad, or just the job title and company, as the person gave it. CVEmber writes the tailored version itself; the master resume never changes, and the same job again refreshes that job's version. userStatedFacts holds what the person said about themselves, saved as stated. Returns the lines changed, the ATS score, and questions[] only for a detail CVEmber cannot take from the resume or the person's words. Do not use for small edits; update_resume does those.

jobDescription.description: The job ad text, as pasted.

userStatedFacts.description: What the person said about themselves, in their exact words. One string or a list of strings. Example: "I have a PhD from Stanford."

name: tailor_resume
title: Save tailored version
